text:
maria: Heads-up: planning to push engine v3.14 + quant profile qv2 to canary pool at 22:00 UTC today. Target ~5% traffic. Need smoke owners and rollback readiness. ETA: ~30m for canary then 2h observation.

 tom: I can own smoke checks for EU region, available during window.

 jen: I'll run KV-cache warmup and latency p95 sweep. Can you post the canary slice IDs and the deploy command?

 maria: Canary slices: slice-17, slice-21. Deploy command (for reference):
```
./deploy --engine v3.14 --quant qv2 --slices slice-17,slice-21 --mode canary
```

 sam: Quick perf note: unit tests green, integration shows a perf bump for seq_len>1024 under synthetic load. I'll attach repro.

 leo: I'll be rollback owner. Rollback criteria: error rate >1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency +30% over baseline. Rollback plan: revert to engine v3.13 + qv1 via hotpatch script `scripts/hotpatch_rollback.sh`.

 maria: MR #3421 already merged (small shim + kernel selector). @sam thanks for the perf flag — we'll gate expansion on p95 < 1200ms.

 deploy-bot: Started canary rollout for slices slice-17,slice-21 at 22:00:12 UTC. Instances: host-17a, host-17b, host-21a, host-21b. Health checks enabled.

 jen: Warm-up done after 5m. Initial p95 baseline 980ms -> current 1150ms (+17%). CPU on host-21b spiked to 78% briefly. No errors observed.

 sam: Repro snippet for the perf test (for anyone who wants to iterate):
```bash
python tools/load_runner.py --seq 2048 --qps 50 --profile perf
```

 tom: Oncall reachable via phone and slack. I prepped rollback credentials and tested `scripts/hotpatch_rollback.sh` in staging.

 deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished on 4/4 hosts: health OK. Observability hooks (traces, metrics) active. Waiting 25m observation window.

 jen: Watching traces and cache hit ratio. If cache-miss rate spikes by >8pp I'll escalate.

 maria: If no alerts in 30m we'll expand to 20% traffic. I'll post explicit go/no-go at 22:40 UTC. Tag me with anything urgent. :eyes:

 leo: If we need to rollback I will execute the hotpatch, notify infra, and open a follow-up thread with postmortem checklist.

 tom: 👍

 maria: Thanks all — appreciate quick checks.
